patch.summary:
Choose Bitbucket Cloud only if your buying job matches “Atlassian git hosting — Free ≤5 users; Standard $3.65/user/mo (min 5-user equivalent); Pre” rather than ThorData's shape. Choose ThorData only if your buying job matches “Budget proxy + scraper tooling — Residential from $2/GB (1GB pack); Web Scraper API credit” rather than Bitbucket Cloud's shape. Workflow advantage: Bitbucket Cloud leans source-control-devops; ThorData leans web-data-collection. Trade-off: you gain focus on one product's motion at the cost of the other's adjacent coverage — no universal winner.

Major differences:
- Positioning: Bitbucket Cloud is Atlassian git hosting — Free ≤5 users; Standard $3.65/user/mo (min 5-user equivalent); Premium $7.25/user/mo.; ThorData is Budget proxy + scraper tooling — Residential from $2/GB (1GB pack); Web Scraper API credit packs from ~$30..
- Company-size focus: Bitbucket Cloud (micro, small-business, mid-market) vs ThorData (solo, micro, small-business).
- Workflow coverage skew: Bitbucket Cloud-leaning source-control-devops vs ThorData-leaning web-data-collection.
- Researched limits: Bitbucket Cloud — Paid plans bill a 5-user floor even for 2-person teams; ThorData — Brand maturity and enterprise compliance story are thinner than Bright Data / Oxylabs.

Limitations — Bitbucket Cloud: Paid plans bill a 5-user floor even for 2-person teams; Ecosystem and Actions marketplace trail GitHub; ThorData: Brand maturity and enterprise compliance story are thinner than Bright Data / Oxylabs; Marketing claims should be validated — score from published packaging, not Fortune-500 slogans.

Poor-fit cases: Bitbucket Cloud is a poor fit when that limitation bites: Paid plans bill a 5-user floor even for 2-person teams · ThorData is a poor fit when that limitation bites: Brand maturity and enterprise compliance story are thinner than Bright Data / Oxylabs · Avoid Bitbucket Cloud if you actually need ThorData's motion (Budget proxy + scraper tooling — Residential from $2/GB (1GB pack); Web Scraper )
